source: computah desktop session 2026-11-04, from the first DeepSeek fk sessions on seed 1
note: Reach and persistence facts; testing status, so random inclusion decides whether they help.

facts.text: On the seed-1 Space Age map the ore patches lie 70-90 tiles west of the kit's roboport at (8,8): iron near (-61,25), stone near (-66,38), copper near (-79,12), coal near (-72,52). The early roboport builds within 44 tiles and carries within 20, so robots cannot reach any patch until the network is extended.

To reach ground outside the starting network, build a chain of roboports (the kit has spares) with poles, each one inside the previous roboport's logistic area so the networks join; robots then build and carry along the whole chain.
facts.when: a source lies outside the roboport's area

facts.text: A goal that looks unreachable is missing a step, usually reach (roboports out to a resource) or a resource found by scanning a wider area; plan the chain backwards from the goal item and keep the plan through slow steps.
Before concluding a resource is missing, scan hundreds of tiles: find_entities_filtered{type='resource', name=...} over the whole charted area. Every starting area has iron, copper, coal and stone.
Cell progress (everything made, at log scale) is what scores, not the episode goal: a mine, a smelter or an extended network built on the way to a long goal is kept and counts.
